visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman holds six colorful Stitch keychains with large branded straps toward the camera, her face partially obscured by her hands against a grey background. (2) Inside a brightly lit convenience store, she browses a display of Stitch blind box sets stacked on a shelf near giant popcorn tubes and promotional posters. (3) Sitting on a grey couch at home, the woman in a light blue t-shirt and denim shorts holds the large retail box while a young boy in a blue shark t-shirt watches with high interest. (4) She tears open the bottom of the main box with her hands, revealing six smaller silver-wrapped blind boxes inside which she spills onto the sofa cushions. (5) The boy picks up a package and they begin unboxing; he holds up a firefighter-themed Stitch keychain for a detailed close-up shot showing its orange strap. (6) The woman opens another box to reveal a doctor-themed Stitch keychain in a white coat, rotating it to show the Disney branding on the back. (7) A young girl in a pink shirt joins the group as the woman unboxes a conductor-themed Stitch wearing a blue uniform and hat. (8) Successive unboxing phases follow for an auto mechanic in orange, a construction worker in a yellow suit resembling a bee, and a chef-themed Stitch keychain with a white hat and spatula. (9) The woman gathers all six unboxed keychains, holding them up collectively in front of the camera to showcase the complete set against the living room background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice introduces the scene over an upbeat, major-key electronic pop BGM with a prominent synthesized drum beat at 124 BPM. (2) A noticeable plastic rustling sound occurs as the camera shifts to a retail store interior, layered with muffled ambient chatter and room resonance. (3) A mid-pitched male voice enters into a conversational dialogue with the woman, discussing the price of the items while the BGM continues at a consistent volume. (4) A loud percussive 'thud' and heavy plastic crinkling SFX mark the start of the unboxing phase on the couch, accompanied by the high-pitched excited shouting of a young boy. (5) Each time a new keychain is revealed, a sharp metallic clinking sound is heard as the toy is handled, followed by the woman's rising intonation expressing joy. (6) A digital 'ding' or bubble SFX is inserted during close-ups of specific keychains to emphasize the reveal, while the background chatter of a small girl adds a secondary vocal layer. (7) The BGM swells slightly in volume during the final montage, where the woman and child's voices overlap in high-arousal celebratory commentary until the track cuts abruptly.
